title: Signed line sheaf pullback forget
statement: Let U:C→D be continuous and V:E→Set a forgetful functor. Suppose left Kan extensions along U^op exist, V preserves them, and target sheafification exists and is preserved by V. Then the constructed E-valued sheaf inverse image followed by V is naturally isomorphic to the set inverse image of the underlying sheaf. This comparison sends the underlying E-valued adjunction unit to the set-valued adjunction unit. The site object and morphism universes may differ; the set universe contains both.

source.place: Tags 03D2, 03D3, 03EL and 0FNY; for derived localization use derived.tex Tags 06YU, 07A4 and 015F. Specialization of the Powers and duals paragraph of the current blueprint.

proof.text: Compose the sheafification-forgetting comparison with the left-Kan-extension-forgetting comparison. Their naturality gives a natural isomorphism. Expand the composite adjunction unit: the defining sheafification unit equation, unit naturality, and Kan-extension unit equation identify the two unit composites.
